title: Colimit-preserving functors out of a Grothendieck abelian category have right adjoints
statement: Fix a universe $u$ for Hom sets and small diagrams [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $\mathcal A$ be a locally $u$-small Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian], with its colimits indexed by $u$-small categories, and let $\mathcal B$ be any locally $u$-small category. Let $F:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be a functor preserving all these small colimits. Then $F$ has a right adjoint: there exist $R:\mathcal B\to\mathcal A$ and bijections $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal B}(FA,B)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal A}(A,RB)$ natural in $A\in\mathcal A$ and $B\in\mathcal B$.

source.place: Tag 07D7, lemma-grothendieck-brown, equivalent functor form: apply representability to A ↦ Hom(F(A),B), naturally in B. Mathlib proves this via the special adjoint functor theorem and its Grothendieck-category instances.
